description: Header definitions for ClearKey Content Access System (CAS) plugin and descrambler classes, including factory classes, plugin interfaces, and session management for Android media DRM.

classes.name: ClearKeyCasFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and querying ClearKey CAS plugins.

classes.name: ClearKeyDescramblerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ClearKey descrambler plugins.

classes.name: ClearKeyCasPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of the CAS plugin interface for ClearKey.

classes.name: ClearKeyDescramblerPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of the descrambler plugin interface for ClearKey.

methods.name: isSystemIdSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given system ID is supported.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a plugin instance for a given system ID.

methods.name: setStatusCallback
methods.description: Sets the status callback for the plugin.

methods.name: setPrivateData
methods.description: Sets private data for the plugin.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a new session, optionally with intent and mode.

methods.name: setSessionPrivateData
methods.description: Sets private data for a session.

methods.name: sendSessionEvent
methods.description: Sends an event for a specific session.

methods.name: provision
methods.description: Performs provisioning with a string parameter.

methods.name: refreshEntitlements
methods.description: Refreshes entitlements with specified type and data.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder component is required for a MIME type.

methods.name: arrayToString
methods.description: Converts byte array to string representation.
